description: Subtext is Fullstory’s standalone product for capturing production web sessions and making them available to AI coding agents for session review and debugging. It records user sessions in a web app and lets agents inspect those sessions, plus related privacy and verification workflows, through hosted tooling.
summary: Subtext exposes two developer integration surfaces for this domain’s product: a hosted OAuth-protected MCP server at `https://api.fullstory.com/mcp/subtext` (also accepting API-key bearer auth) and an npm-distributed setup wizard CLI `npx @subtextdev/subtext-wizard` that can authenticate interactively via OAuth or with `SUBTEXT_API_KEY`.
